verdict.rationale: Alma is an immigration law firm that offers attorney-led visa services through a client portal, not a developer platform or API product, so a sandbox test environment separate from production data does not apply to this kind of product. The evidence shows no API surface (all OpenAPI probes returned 404) and nothing that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
